name: Transco Dalton Lateral Expansion II Project
monitor_reason: length: new-loop mileage is not sourced; 115 mi is the lateral path, not new pipe. Project also includes compression. No FERC filing yet.
researcher_notes: Not an existing GEM row: no Dalton Lateral row in the 2026-10-02 snapshot (the 2017 Dalton Expansion, CP15-117, 111 mi, is also absent from the snapshot). EIA August 2026 release, sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, Excel row 36: Announced, in service 2029, 115 mi path, 460 MMcf/d, looping plus compression, Georgia. Williams 10-Q for June 2026 says Transco plans a FERC certificate application in 2027, in service as early as Q4 2029, up to 460 Mdth/d. Open season ran Oct 18 to Nov 7, 2024. Sponsor and endpoints (Station 115, Coweta County, to about milepost 113, Murray County) and a concrete step (open season, anchor shipper precedent agreement) are met. Fails the 25 km length rule because no source states the length of new loop. Recheck when the FERC application or pre-filing gives loop miles; if 15.5 mi or more, add as an expansion row with PipelineName set to the parent Transcontinental Gas Pipeline roster spelling.
